# Loading packages
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ArchR)
library(Seurat)
library(BSgenome)
library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library("GenomicFeatures")
library(parallel)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(factoextra)
library(dendextend)
library(ggdendro)
library(Gviz)
```
# Setting up general ArchR parameters
```{r}
addArchRLocking(locking = TRUE)
addArchRThreads(threads = 64)
```
## Loading the project
```{r}
## Loading the project
proj_test_5 <- loadArchRProject("~/Scratch_MF/ATAC/sc_Mm/combined_analysis_final/Data/combined_analysis_v5_annotated_peakscalled/")

## Extracting embedding and metadata to plot the UMAP in ggplot2/Seurat
umap_coordinates <- getEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj_test_5, embedding = "UMAP")
meta <- getCellColData(proj_test_5) %>% as.data.frame()
umap_plotting <- cbind(umap_coordinates, meta[rownames(umap_coordinates),])
umap_plotting <- umap_plotting %>% dplyr::rename("UMAP1" = "IterativeLSI#UMAP_Dimension_1", "UMAP2" = "IterativeLSI#UMAP_Dimension_2")

## Colour palette
palette <- c("Bcells" = "#7FB3D5",
              "uNK" = "#08519C",
              "Macrophages" = "#3182BD",
              "Monocytes" = "#08306B",
             "Erythroid" = "#6A3D9A",
             "DecidualStromal" = "#E6AB02",
             "EndothelialMaternal" = "#C71585",
              "Fibroblast" = "#A6761D",
             "ParietalYolkSac" = "#969696",
             "LabyrinthTrophoblastProgenitors" = "#005F66",
             "JunctionalZoneTrophoblastProgenitors" = "#007F86",
             "Spongiotrophoblast" = "#009FA6",
             "GlycogenTrophoblast" = "#00BFC4",
             "SinusoidalTGC" = "#33CCD1",
             "SyncytiotrophoblastI" = "#66D9DE",
             "SyncytiotrophoblastII" = "#99E6EA")

## Plotting UMAP
p1 <- ggplot(umap_plotting, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = FinalCellTypeAnnotation_fromRNA)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme(panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = palette)
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/a_ATAC_UMAP_Annotated.png", plot = p1, width = 12, height = 10)
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/a_ATAC_UMAP_Annotated.pdf", plot = p1, width = 12, height = 10)

## Cleaning up
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), "palette"))
```
## Plotting the accompanying legend
```{r}
legend_data <- data.frame(cell_type = names(palette), color = palette)
rownames(legend_data) <- NULL
legend_data$category <- c(rep("Immune cells", 4), rep("Other blood cells", 1), rep("Uterine", 1), rep("Endothelial", 1), rep("Stromal", 1), rep("Yolk sac", 1), rep("Trophoblast", 7))
legend_data$cell_label <- c("B-cells", "uNK", "Macrophages", "Monocytes", "Erythroid", "DSC", "Endothelial (M)", "Fibroblast", "Parietal", "Labyrinth progenitors", "JZ progenitors", "Spongiotrophoblast", "GlyT", "sinusoidal-TGC", "SynT I", "SynT II")
legend_data$y <- c(11:8, 6, 4, 2, 11, 9, 7:1)
legend_data$x <- c(rep(0,7), rep(1,9))
legend_data

p_legend <- ggplot(legend_data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = cell_type), size = 5) +  # colored box
  geom_text(aes(label = cell_label), hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.2, size = 4) + # cell type labels
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(legend_data$color, legend_data$cell_type)) +
  # Add category headers as text (we place them manually)
  geom_text(
    data = subset(legend_data, !duplicated(category)),
    aes(x = x - 0.2, y = y + 1, label = category),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
  xlim(-0.5, 2) +   # space for labels
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


# Save figure
ggsave("Visuals/a_ATAC_UMAP_Legend.png", plot = p_legend, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("Visuals/a_ATAC_UMAP_Legend.pdf", plot = p_legend, width = 6, height = 4)
```
